name: ngi-admissions
description: NGI Admissions landing page — Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind frontend, Express + MongoDB API

scripts.install:workspaces: npm --prefix api install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build
